svg.title: Native SQLite and PostgreSQL versus ULMDB-backed SQL tables

cc:Work.dc:title: Native SQLite and PostgreSQL versus ULMDB-backed SQL tables
cc:Work.dc:description: Gray bars are native tables without ULMDB. Teal bars are the same SQL backed by ULMDB. All five workloads and all three SQLite record sizes are shown, including slower cases. PostgreSQL is an earlier separate measurement.
